Entities

One card per thing in the game. Stats are the exact values the game uses (GameData). Source: design/entities/*.yaml

Bro (default) player

The player character, traced pixel for pixel from the Rambo reference sheet. At the reference's native size he stands about 1.3 blocks tall (31 px); holding Crouch lowers him to one block (26 px sprite, 24 px hitbox) and slows him down. Runs, jumps, sprays rifle fire; dies after max_hp hits (bullets, or blasts which take several hearts at once). Each death costs one run life and restarts the current level (design/run.yaml). Every future Bro copies this file and changes what makes them unique.

Balal (playable Bro) player

A glass-cannon Bro. His rifle fires twice as fast as the default Bro's and the magazine holds 60 rounds, but the bullets die out after a short range and fly all over the place. He runs faster and jumps higher. His knife needs two hits - the first one throws the enemy back and leaves him stunned, standing in a corner unable to move or shoot for about two seconds, the second one kills. Has his own sprite (art/sprites/blala.yaml) - dark skin, short black hair, white tank top, green pants - for now in the default Bro's poses. Pick him on the character select screen at the start of the game.

Grenade weapon

The Bro carries grenades_per_level grenades (Grenade key). They come back only when he finishes a level — dying and restarting the level keeps whatever he had left. A thrown grenade is a small round ball with its lever on top (the pin is pulled), drawn from the pineapple grenade reference (refrences/items). It flies in an arc, bounces off blocks and rolls, blinking red faster and faster, and after fuse_time explodes with the power of one explosive barrel (same radius, same damage, breaks blocks, hurts the Bro too if he is close). Enemies that see a live grenade near them panic after flee_reaction and run away from it until it is gone. Throwing a grenade while hanging on a wall is a mistake - it goes off in his hand at once, right next to him.

Mook (enemy soldier) enemy

Masked soldier, the same size as the Bro (traced from the default enemy reference). Patrols back and forth and turns at walls and ledges. He only sees forward — if the Bro is in front of him, within vision range, roughly at his height, with no blocks in between, he shows "!", waits reaction_time, then fires bursts. After losing sight of the Bro he keeps watching for forget_time, then patrols again. Shot from behind, he turns around. Every hit sprays blood; when he dies he bursts, falls, and his body stays for the rest of the level in a spreading pool of blood (explosions still toss bodies around). Killed by a blast or shot in the head, he loses his head (head.yaml).

Kamikaze (suicide bomber) enemy

Wears a dynamite vest and holds a lit stick. Patrols like a mook and sees the same way (forward only, no blocks in between). When he spots the Bro he screams and sprints straight at him, jumping over low walls. When he gets within trigger_range he blows up — killing himself and, at full blast, the Bro too. Shooting him is the answer, but he also explodes when he dies (after death_fuse), so kill him far away. His blast breaks blocks, sets off barrels and kills other enemies too. Leaves no body — only blood.

Brute (mini-boss) enemy

Two blocks tall, gas mask, armor vest, a minigun in each hand. Walks slowly. He sees much further than a mook and much higher and lower, and also notices the Bro behind him when he is close (he turns around). When he spots the Bro his guns spin up, then he sprays long bursts from both guns in a wide fan (spread_angle), alternating guns. His bullets chew through blocks and barrels. A health bar appears at the top of the screen while you fight him. When he dies he stays down in a big pool of blood.

Terrain block terrain

24×24 solid tile that levels are built from. Bullets (player and enemy) chip it — every hit adds more cracks across its face — and at 0 HP it bursts into debris and is gone for good. Any block whose center is inside an explosion is destroyed at once. Blocks with open sky above (grass_clearance air tiles) automatically become grass with hanging strands; tunnel and cave floors stay bare earth. Each block's variant is picked from its map position, so the same level always looks the same.

Stats — in code: GameData.BLOCK.<name>

NameValueMeaning
size24 pxSide of one block — the same as the crouched Bro's hitbox height, so a crouching Bro fits through a one-block gap. Everything is measured in blocks of this size.
hp3 hitsBullet hits needed to destroy one block. Each hit before the last adds cracks.

Explosive barrel hazard

Red drum with a skull, about 1.4 blocks tall (a bit shorter than the Bro), drawn from refrences/barrel. A hit from any bullet (or a nearby blast) makes it bulge and sets it burning — fire runs up both of its sides — after fuse_time it explodes. Barrels that touch each other (side by side, stacked or diagonal) explode together as ONE bigger blast — radius and damage grow with every extra barrel, and it looks different (mushroom fireball + shockwave instead of a small blast). Barrels further away that are inside the blast catch fire and go off a moment later (chain reaction). Solid — you can stand on it, and it falls if the ground under it is destroyed.

Explosion effect

Everything inside the radius is hit at once — blocks are destroyed (so a blast always opens a hole several blocks wide), enemies take blast damage, the Bro loses hearts, barrels catch fire, and bodies are tossed. One source (a single barrel or a kamikaze) uses one of three small blasts (picked from its map position, so the same barrel always looks the same). A cluster of touching barrels instead plays a mushroom fireball plus a ground shockwave scaled to the cluster, with a small blast on every barrel in it, more smoke, more fire and a harder screen shake.

Blood effect

Every bullet hit on an enemy (alive or dead) sprays blood in the bullet's direction (one of three sprays, cycling, plus loose droplets). A death adds a radial burst (one of two). Every loose droplet is a real falling drop — it flies, falls with gravity and, where it hits a block, leaves a stain that stays (on top it splats wider, on walls and ceilings it is a small mark). Stains belong to the block, so they vanish when it is destroyed. When a body comes to rest, a pool (one of three) spreads under it and stays for the rest of the level; it is stuck to the block underneath, so it disappears if that block is destroyed. Bursts also throw red chunks of flesh that land on top of blocks and stay there as lumps. A kamikaze (and any body shot to pieces) bursts into a shower of gore and leaves only a pool — no body.

Corpse (enemy body) effect

A killed mook or Brute leaves a body that stays for the rest of the level. It flails (hurt pose) while flying and lies flat when it lands, with a pool of blood under it. Bodies are still physical — walk through one and it is nudged and dragged along the ground without leaving its lying pose; shoot one and it is knocked back and tossed a bit (and bleeds) — three bullets make it burst into gore (blood only, no blast); explosions throw them hard. A body whose head was blown off (head.yaml) lies headless and pumps blood out of the neck for a few seconds. Bodies never block the Bro or bullets of enemies.

Grass blades effect

Tufts of grass blades standing on top of every surface (grass) block. No sprite — every blade is drawn by the game pixel by pixel and moves on its own spring, so the grass is alive. It sways gently in the wind (a wave runs across the level), bends away from the Bro and enemies standing in it, is pressed down to half height under a body lying on it and gets flicked by anyone running through, whips away from explosions (the closer the blast, the harder), keeps any blood that falls on it (drops, death bursts and the pool under a body turn the blade tips red for the rest of the level), and bursts into green blade particles when its block is destroyed.

Severed head effect

When a mook dies in an explosion, or a Bro bullet hits him in the head (a head shot kills at once), his head is blown off. The head flies off away from the hit, spinning and pouring blood (engine particles plus real drops that stain the ground), bounces, rolls to a stop and stays for the rest of the level. It never blocks anything — the Bro running into it kicks it away (spinning, spraying blood), bullets fly through it and only knock it about a little (a few drops each) — but the Bro's knife bursts it into blood. The body keeps the matching headless pose, with blood pumping out of the neck (corpse.yaml fountain_*). Later Bros can carry weapons that behead on any kill (bullet stat behead "always").

Torn-apart body effect

A soldier killed by an explosion (a grenade or a barrel), or a body lying in a blast, is torn apart into the drawn body pieces from the torn reference (refrences/enemies/default/torn.jpg) - torso, two arms, a straight and a bent leg, and a few scraps of flesh, each with a torn, bloody end. His head flies off as a Head (head.yaml). Every piece is thrown away from the blast spinning, trails blood from its torn end while it flies (engine particles plus real drops that stain the blocks), bounces a few times spraying blood, and then lies flat on the ground for the rest of the level. A gore burst and a blood pool go with it. Kamikazes (their vest goes off anyway) and the Brute (boss) are not torn apart; a sprite without piece_* animations is just tossed.

Fixed on screen. Top-left — one heart per Bro hit point (grey when lost), the lives left, rounds in the loaded magazine, and one magazine icon per spare magazine (up to 3), and under them one grenade icon per grenade left (3 per level). Top-center — level number, loop and level name. Top-right — kills / kill quota (turns green when met). Center — big messages (KILL N MORE, EXIT OPEN, LEVEL CLEAR, YOU DIED, RUN OVER). While the Brute is fighting, his health bar is shown under the top line. Text uses the pixel font (sprite "font") with a dark outline.

Run loop

Source: design/run.yaml — in code: GameData.RUN

A run is endless and every level is generated fresh (scripts/level_gen.gd) - fight, fight, BOSS (a Brute), then a safe-house HUB where the Bro can walk around and restock ammo, refill hearts and lives, and refill grenades - then it starts again, every level with real height - hills with stairs, valleys, narrow gaps and towers of floating platforms, enemies on every level of it - and every level a little bigger, fuller and tougher (more enemies, more kamikazes, higher kill quota, more barrels). Each level has at least min_enemies enemies; the exit flag opens after the kill quota (a boss level needs every enemy dead, the Brute included). Hearts and ammo carry over from level to level, so the hub matters. Dying costs one life and restarts the current level (same layout, kills reset, hearts refilled); losing the last life ends the run and you start again from the first fight with full lives. The three hand-made maps listed under 'levels' are no longer part of the run - they stay as reference and test maps.

NameValueMeaning
lives3 livesLives at the start of a run. Each death costs one and restarts the current level.
clear_delay2.0 sHow long "LEVEL CLEAR" shows before the next level loads.
run_over_delay3.0 sHow long "RUN OVER" shows after the last life is lost, before a new run starts.
background_parallax0.3 ratioThe jungle backdrop (game/assets/backgrounds/jungle.jpg, scripts/background.gd) scrolls at this fraction of the camera's speed — 0 would glue it to the screen, 1 would pin it to the world. It is scaled to just cover the screen and mirrored end to end, so it never runs out.
boss_every3 levelsEvery this many fights the last one is a boss level (a Brute), and a hub follows it.
min_enemies15 enemiesEnemies in the very first level (a boss level gets this many soldiers plus the Brute).
enemies_per_depth2 enemiesExtra enemies for every fight already cleared in this run (plus a random 0-3).
max_enemies70 enemiesCap on enemies per level.
width_base110 tilesWidth of the first level (a block is 24 px).
width_per_depth6 tilesExtra width for every fight already cleared.
width_max260 tilesCap on level width.
boss_width90 tilesWidth of the first boss arena (it also grows with width_per_depth per boss cleared).
platform_towers_base4 towersTowers of floating platforms (2-4 tiers, each two blocks higher than the last, one jump apart) in the first level. Enemies and barrels also stand on them.
platform_towers_per_depth0.5 towersExtra towers for every fight cleared.
platform_towers_max14 towersCap on towers per level.
kamikaze_base0.12 shareShare of the soldiers that are kamikazes in the first level.
kamikaze_per_depth0.02 shareExtra kamikaze share for every fight cleared.
kamikaze_max0.4 shareCap on the kamikaze share.
barrel_clusters_base4 clustersExplosive barrel clusters (1-3 barrels each) in the first level (a boss arena always has 5 near the Brute).
barrel_clusters_per_depth0.5 clustersExtra barrel clusters for every fight cleared.
quota_base0.6 shareShare of the enemies that must be killed to open the exit, in the first level.
quota_per_depth0.02 shareExtra share required for every fight cleared.
quota_max0.9 shareCap on the kill-quota share.

#LevelMapKill quotaEnemies in mapNotes

Storyboards

Bro — moveset

The beats every Bro must sell. New Bros copy this board and change only what is unique to them.

1. Ready
Stands his ground, rifle up, bandana fluttering. Always looks ready to fight.

2. Run
Fast, forward-leaning sprint. Body bobs on each step, gun never lowers.
sfx: footstep

3. Jump
Tucked legs, bandana flips up. Jump is high and snappy, not floaty.
sfx: jump

4. Shoot
Gun kicks back 1px each shot, muzzle flash at the tip. Hold to spray.
sfx: shoot

5. Crouch
Hold Crouch (S / Down) and the Bro drops into a low crouch (about 1.6 blocks instead of 2). He moves slower but can still shoot. Under a low ceiling he stays down until there is room to stand.

6. Destroy
Bullets chew through dirt. Three hits and a block bursts into debris. The Bro is about two blocks tall, so he needs a two-block-high hole to get through.
sfx: block_break

7. Spotted
A mook only sees forward. Step in front of him, near his height, with nothing in between, and a "!" pops up — you have half a second.
sfx: enemy_alert

8. Firefight
He fires slow red bursts. Jump over them, or break the block under him. Two hits and he drops.
sfx: enemy_shoot

9. Hit
Each enemy hit costs a heart and makes the Bro blink (briefly invulnerable). Lose all three and you lose a life; the level restarts. Blasts take two or three hearts at once and throw you.
sfx: player_hurt

10. Knife
Up close, press Knife (K or C). He draws the blade, then slashes with a silver swoosh. Any normal enemy dies from one cut, thrown back in a shower of blood that stains the ground; the Brute needs six.
sfx: knife_stab

11. Ammo from kills
Every knife kill gives a spare magazine — "+ magazine" floats up over his head and fades. The HUD shows one magazine per spare, three at most.

12. Run and gun
Firing on the move — he keeps his stride and the rifle slides a pixel forward and back under his hand on every shot.
sfx: shoot

13. Hang on
Jump into the side of a block and he drives his knife into it and hangs there by one arm, body and legs swaying under him. Jump kicks off the wall; after a moment he starts sliding down.
sfx: knife_stab

14. Grenade
Q throws a grenade in an arc. It bounces, blinks red faster and faster and blows up after two seconds like a barrel. Three per level, back only when the level is finished.
sfx: grenade_throw

15. Run!
A soldier who sees a live grenade near him panics after a moment and runs from it. The Brute doesn't care.
sfx: enemy_panic

16. Not on the wall
Throwing a grenade while hanging on a wall is a mistake — no room to throw, it goes off in his hand.
sfx: explosion_small

17. Wall flip
Hanging on a wall, press Jump — he kicks off and somersaults away from it. A wall too short for the knife (his upper body already above it) is not grabbed; he just keeps going.
sfx: jump

Run loop (roguelike)

What one run of the game feels like. This is the design target every feature serves.

🚁

1. Drop in
Helicopter drops a random Bro into a procedurally built jungle level.

2. Blast through
Run right, shoot everything. Terrain and enemies break apart.

3. Meet the quota
Built: every level has a kill quota. Kill enough (bullets, barrels, kamikaze blasts all count) and the extraction flag opens; touch it to move on. Three levels, then the run loops.
sfx: quota_reached

⛓

4. Rescue a prisoner
Free a caged Bro — you instantly swap to them (new weapon, new special). Also +1 life.

⬆

5. Pick an upgrade
End of level — choose 1 of 3 random perks (fire rate, double jump, bigger blasts...).

💀

6. Boss
Every 3rd level ends in a boss arena that can be torn apart.

↺

7. Die → start over
Built: three lives per run; a death restarts the level. Lose all lives and the run ends. Planned: unlocked Bros and meta-currency carry over to the next run.

Barrels & explosions

How blasts must read on screen — every size has its own look, and bigger piles must feel bigger.

1. Spot the barrel
Red drum with a skull and crossbones, always placed near enemies. A bit shorter than the Bro — you can stand on it.

2. Light it
One bullet makes it bulge and pop its lid, fire runs up both sides and the drum flashes hot. Under half a second to get clear.
sfx: barrel_ignite

3. Single blast
One barrel = one small blast (fireball, starburst or plume — the same barrel always looks the same). Opens a hole about 2 blocks wide.
sfx: explosion_small

4. Starburst
The second small look — white rays first, then a ring of fire with sparks.

5. Plume
The third small look — a tall column that throws fire upward.

6. Cluster blast
Barrels touching each other go off as ONE blast — a mushroom fireball, bigger with every barrel, a small blast on each drum, more smoke, harder shake.
sfx: explosion_big

7. Shockwave
A ring races along the ground out to the cluster's full radius — that is exactly how far the damage reaches.

8. Chain reaction
Barrels further away that sit inside a blast catch fire and go off a moment later — piles ripple.

9. Living grass
The blades on every surface block are alive — they sway in the wind, part around anyone standing in them, whip away from every blast, keep the blood that falls on them, and burst into green bits when their block is blown apart.

10. Torn apart
A soldier caught in a blast is torn into pieces (torn reference) - head, torso, two arms, two legs and scraps of flesh fly off spinning, each trailing blood from its torn end, bounce and stay where they land.
sfx: blood_splat

11. Pieces on the ground
Every piece lies flat where it stopped for the rest of the level; the drops it shed on the way stain the blocks.

Enemies & blood

Each enemy has one job and one tell. Every kill is loud and messy, and the bodies stay.

1. Hit
Every bullet that lands sprays blood the way the bullet was flying (three different sprays, used in turn). The loose drops really fall and stain every block they land on — the ground stays red.

2. Kill
A death bursts (two kinds) and the body is thrown back.
sfx: blood_splat

3. Bodies stay
Where a body lands, a pool spreads under it and stays all level (three kinds). Blasts still toss bodies around.

4. Kick the bodies
Bodies lie in one of two poses (50 / 50) and stay physical. Walk through one and it hops and gets dragged along; shoot it and it is knocked back and tossed a little, bleeding again.

5. Heads off
Kill a mook with a blast, or shoot him in the head, and his head flies off spinning and pouring blood; it bounces, rolls and stays. Blood pumps out of the neck for seconds. Bullets fly through a loose head and just knock it about — the knife bursts it.

6. Kamikaze spots you
Dynamite vest, lit stick. Same eyes as a mook — he only sees forward.

7. The charge
He screams and sprints at you, hopping walls. Up close he blows you both up — three hearts, a full-health Bro dies.
sfx: kamikaze_scream

8. Shoot him early
One bullet kills him — but his vest still goes off a third of a second later. Kill him far away, or next to his friends.

9. The Brute
Mini-boss, about three blocks tall, two miniguns. Sees twice as far as a mook and spots you on platforms; hears you behind him.
sfx: brute_alert

10. Spin up
The barrels whine for most of a second before he fires — your cue to get behind something solid.
sfx: minigun_spinup

11. Spray
Long alternating bursts in a wide fan. They chew through cover and set off barrels — so lure him next to some.
sfx: minigun_fire

Blala

The glass cannon. Two SMGs that spray a wall of short-range bullets, a fast runner and a high jumper - nothing like the Rambo Bro.

1. Two SMGs
Black buzz cut, white tank top, green pants - and an SMG in each hand, one across his chest and one held out front.

2. Spray
Twice the Bro's fire rate and a 60-round magazine, but the bullets fan out wide and die after about 5 blocks. Get close.

3. On the move
He runs faster and jumps higher than the Bro, and keeps spraying while he runs.

4. Two stabs
His knife needs two hits - the first knocks the enemy back and leaves him stunned, the second kills.
